restlet.description: Create, edit, describe, run and delete saved searches over JSON. Primarily called by netsuite-cli via `restlet call`; contract documented in the cp-saved-search skill. GET ?id= describes; GET ?id=&run=T runs; POST creates; POST {"run":true,...} runs a definition without saving it; PUT updates (full-definition replace); DELETE ?id= removes a search.
restlet.name: CP | Saved Search RESTlet
